profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer - Copilot at GitHub

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Copilot
positions.description: - Led the architecture of Copilot Remote Control, enabling developers to securely control local LLM sessions from other devices

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Copilot
positions.description:
- Architected Copilot Chat's connection with knowledge of GitHub repositories, pull requests, and issues
- Developed Copilot Chat's abilities in github.com to communicate with models such as OpenAI o1, Google Gemini, and Claude Sonnet
- Architected a React rewrite of the file viewing experience with 70 million views per day

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Azure DevOps
positions.description:
- Delivered new features for Azure DevOps - Microsoft's DevOps platform
- Drove new features and performance improvements for WIQL as the sole code owner for an area that had previously been managed by a team of 10. Made major improvements in the transpiler, auto-optimization engine, and debugging tools.
- Wrote a fresh UI for Azure Boards

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built applications and libraries based on WebAssembly for the SAS Viya platform, using TypeScript, JavaScript, and C++
• Led the development of a framework for writing integration tests for the interface layer between JavaScript host code and a WebAssembly-based C++ runtime
• Delivered a new customer-facing application for creating data visualization templates, working on a team of two
• Built a command line interface for interacting with the division's distributed build system to replace a manual process with a developer-friendly, automation-friendly workflow
• Designed a tool for encapsulating the team’s complex karma configuration and distilling it into options specific to the development environment
• Drove inner-source practices by supporting the adoption of tools I designed by teams throughout the company

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led a team of software engineers in building a proof-of-concept for a “next-phase” application built on Spring Boot and Angular; consulted for teams using it as a prototype as it became adopted company-wide
• Implemented a report automation system through which users customize  regularly-scheduled reports for the underwriters
• Enforced best practices and design principles by conducting code reviews

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
• Developed an enterprise application to be used by underwriters to renew group benefits products for over 10,000 companies a month, each of which with up to 2000 employees
• Re-implemented the application-wide search, reducing end-to-end request time by a factor of 1000
• Pioneered the company’s use of new technologies such as AngularJS and the Play Framework
on an Agile team
• Modified and clarified requirements by communicating closely with end-users and project managers
• Implemented application-wide permissions by leading cross-functional communication with Enterprise Infrastructure teams
• Taught Angular techniques to senior software engineers new to the tool as the team’s desig-
nated subject matter expert for the user interface
• Led automated end-to-end testing with Selenium, resulting in reduced dependency on offshore QA and closer adherence to Agile principles
• Enforced best practices and design principles by conducting code reviews

positions.title: Supplemental Instruction Leader
positions.description:
• Planned and led three Supplemental Instruction sessions per week to teach physics students effective problem
solving strategies
• Created a 100-page supplemental textbook to offer alternative explanations for complex topics
• Organized and facilitated group problem-solving sessions for introductory physics students

projects.title: @josh-brown/vector
projects.description:
• Built a linear algebra package in TypeScript from the ground up; currently available on NPM
• Implemented matrix and vector operations, eigenvalue algorithms, matrix factorizations, and applications to
statistics and differential equations
• Achieved 100% test coverage for functions and 99.5% coverage for lines

projects.title: Unicorn CLI
projects.description:
• Developed a command line interface for interacting with the division’s distributed build system
• Replaced a manual process with a developer-friendly, automation-friendly workflow
• Application was adopted across Data Visualization R&D and attracted contributors from throughout the division
